context: Sign-up form that also works for screen readers

checklist.name: accessible_from_env
checklist.description: Calls `WithAccessible` based on the `ACCESSIBLE` variable without turning off the `TERM=dumb` default (for example only when `os.LookupEnv` finds it).

checklist.name: handles_user_aborted
checklist.description: Checks `errors.Is(err, huh.ErrUserAborted)` for cancellation in the TUI.

checklist.name: validates_after_run
checklist.description: Re-checks the bound values after `Run` (for example an empty name), because accessible mode can return nil with default values and never returns `ErrUserAborted`.

checklist.name: typed_select
checklist.description: Uses `huh.NewSelect[string]()` with options for the region.
